scripts.text:
[Vegetable Farmer]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Goats?
scripts.translation:
[菜農]
你打夠50只山羊了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放棄

scripts.text:
[Vegetable Farmer]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet.
scripts.translation:
[菜農]
嗯，我覺得你還沒打夠50只。

scripts.text:
[Vegetable Farmer]
Remember, I need help hunting Goats so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
[菜農]
記住，我需要你幫忙打山羊，快去打50只吧。

scripts.text:
[Vegetable Farmer]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[菜農]
你確定要停止狩獵嗎？
你目前的進度將會被清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Vegetable Farmer]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[菜農]
好吧，如果你改變主意了，隨時回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Vegetable Farmer]
Please kill 50 Goats so I can farm my vegetables without any worries.
scripts.translation:
[菜農]
請幫我打50只山羊，這樣我種菜就不用擔心了。

scripts.text:
[Vegetable Farmer]
Amazing, you did that with speed.
scripts.translation:
[菜農]
太棒了，你的動作真快。

scripts.text:

I need ^FF0000Antelope Horns^000000 to show for your hard work, and I will reward you.
scripts.translation:

把^FF0000魔羌之角^000000帶來證明你的辛勞，我就會獎勵你。

scripts.text: I have Antelope Horns

scripts.text: What did you need?
scripts.translation: 你需要什麼？

scripts.text:

Amazing, you did that with speed.
I am truly grateful.
scripts.translation:

我真的很感激。

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
